offline_policy: Anything listed here must be labeled network-only in field UI unless a dated cache/precomputed export is present on the Pi.

sources.name: TrailSplits API
sources.offline_path: pre-trip export to compact GeoJSON/MBTiles/elevation JSON if terms allow
sources.label: Requires network unless cached before hike.

sources.name: openrouteservice
sources.status: network-only public API or self-host backend
sources.offline_path: Garden/NukeBox self-host or pre-trip route export to GPX/GeoJSON
sources.label: Requires network/self-host reach unless route is downloaded.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap + Overpass
sources.offline_path: downloaded extracts/route packs/MBTiles; use politely and attribute OSM
sources.label: Live search requires network; downloaded extracts can work offline.

sources.name: Open Topo Data
sources.status: network-only public API unless self-hosted/cache generated
sources.offline_path: precompute elevation samples into route pack JSON
sources.label: Requires network unless elevation profile is cached.

sources.name: Waymarked Trails
sources.status: backend/import candidate, not Pi live dependency
sources.offline_path: pre-trip import of route relation summaries/tiles
sources.label: Requires backend/network unless exported.

sources.name: Visible Planets API
sources.offline_path: precompute night-hike sky JSON for trip dates
sources.label: Requires network unless cached/precomputed.

sources.name: AstroSky
sources.offline_path: self-host on Garden/NukeBox or export trip summaries
sources.label: Requires network/self-host reach unless synced.

sources.name: Stellarium / Gaia Sky
sources.offline_path: export static charts/images/JSON to Pi; do not run heavy planetarium stack on Zero
sources.label: Generated outputs can be offline; generators are not Pi-field runtime.

sources.name: Valhalla / OSRM / Wanderer
sources.offline_path: run on Garden/NukeBox/server and sync selected GPX/GeoJSON/MBTiles summaries
sources.label: Not Pi Zero runtime; use synced outputs offline.
